component_gradients.zero_norm_cosine: A cosine is null when either vector has zero norm.

adam_decomposition.common_denominator: Actual post-update second moment, with the actual step's bias correction and epsilon.
adam_decomposition.rounding_remainder_semantics: The first-moment remainder includes component accumulation, clipping and Adam moment rounding; the final delta residual also includes parameter storage and optimizer arithmetic rounding.
adam_decomposition.interpretation: These additive terms share the actual denominator. They are not counterfactual steps with separately recomputed second moments.

no_mc.reason: MC weight is already zero in the actual objective.

projection_semantics: Positive projections predict an increase of the fixed-before-competitor demonstration gap; nonlinear residuals and after-step competitor changes are separate.
counterfactual_semantics: Each non-alias branch performs one independent update from the same source state. Zero-current-gradient uses explicit zeros; zero-first-moment preserves second moments and steps; reset-Adam clears state only.
